name: Lich

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.effect: Target must pass WILL save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. Target can repeat the save at end of each turn.

actions.name: Power Word Kill
actions.effect: One creature within 18m with 20 HP or fewer is instantly killed. No save. Usable once per encounter.

actions.name: Disintegrate
actions.effect: Ranged magical attack. If this reduces the target to 0 HP, they are disintegrated into dust. PHYS save for half damage.

actions.name: Finger of Death
actions.effect: Ranged magical attack at long range. A humanoid killed by this rises as a zombie permanently under the Lich's control.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.effect: When a creature within 18m casts a spell, the Lich can attempt to counter it. Roll magic vs magic: if the Lich wins, the spell fails.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.effect: +5 to all defenses against one attack, and immunity to magic missile until start of its next turn.

traits.name: Phylactery
traits.desc: If the Lich is destroyed, it reforms near its phylactery in 1d10 days with full HP. The phylactery must be destroyed to permanently kill the Lich.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: +2d6 to saves against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Arcane Mastery
traits.desc: The Lich's spells cannot be resisted by creatures with fewer than 3 shields. Such creatures automatically fail saves against its magic.

lore: Liches are the most feared of all undead: archmages who achieved immortality by binding their soul to a phylactery through forbidden rituals. They spend centuries accumulating knowledge and power, often ruling from hidden sanctums with armies of undead servants.
